parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description:
The name of the application to which the live stream belongs.

>  A value of asterisk (\*) specifies all applications under the domain name.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description:
The name of the live stream.

>  A value of asterisk (\*) specifies all live streams in the application.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-audio-audit-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLiveAudioAuditConfig --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --DomainName 'example.com' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppName liveApp0000
